title: Ravens GM warns of first-round talent 'drop-off' in 2026 NFL Draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ravens GM warns of first-round talent 'drop-off' in 2026 NFL Draft
sources.description: Ravens GM Eric DeCosta was candid in his assessment of a "solid" 2026 NFL Draft class that has a talent "drop-off" midway through its first round.
